title: CTRLEval: An Unsupervised Reference-Free Metric for Evaluating Controlled Text Generation
reasoning: The paper develops and tests an evaluation metric for topic-controlled text generation. One of the topics used in the experiments to control text generation is 'religion', as stated in Section 4.1. The metric evaluates how well the generated text adheres to this specified topic, which constitutes a form of evaluating a religious topic.
